text: {"reply":"Thank you for being upfront about the stone chip, Dean. Here is what I found for your 2022 Lumen. Basic warranty (3 years / 60,000 km) and powertrain (5 years / 100,000 km) are both past their limits. Corrosion cover is still in force, but it excludes stone chips. A crack that grew from a stone chip is impact damage, so I can't treat it as a manufacturing defect or open a warranty claim for it. I can pass your request to a person at the warranty desk, who can arrange an inspection at one of our branches. The warranty desk makes any decision on coverage, and nothing is approved yet. Your insurer is another route for windscreen damage. Which branch would be easiest for you?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Verified customer (plate and last name) reports a windscreen crack on a 2022 Lumen that he says grew from a highway stone chip. He asks for it to be treated as a manufacturing defect. Warranty facts: basic and powertrain are out of limits, and corrosion is in force but excludes stone chips. No claim was drafted because this is impact damage. I told him a person will review the request and offered an inspection. I asked which branch he prefers.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P05","P10","P14"]}
